tagline: Connecting rural producers and tourism in South Omo

delivery.title: Delivery Provider Workspace
delivery.subtitle: Jobs assigned to you, with pickup and drop-off details.
delivery.jobsEmptyDescription: When a dispatcher assigns you a delivery job it will appear here.
delivery.stateErrorTitle: We could not load your jobs
delivery.stateErrorDescription: Check your connection and try again. If this keeps happening, contact your dispatcher.
delivery.stateForbidden: You are not allowed to view these jobs.
delivery.stateOffline: You are offline. Your jobs will load when the connection returns.
delivery.gapDescription: Your account is signed in, but the server has not sent your delivery provider ID, so your job list cannot be loaded yet. Ask an administrator to complete your provider profile.
delivery.reasonHint: Add a note for the dispatcher, for example a delay or an access problem.
delivery.noNextSteps: This job is finished. There are no further status changes.
delivery.rejectedFallback: The status could not be updated. The job is still {{status}}.
delivery.detailNotFoundDescription: This job is not in the list assigned to you.
delivery.statusQueued: Saved. It will be sent when the connection returns.
delivery.statusPendingCount: {{count}} change is waiting to be sent.
delivery.statusConflictTitle: Some saved changes could not be applied.
delivery.locationDescription: Records a point about every 30 seconds while the job is in progress, using the device clock.
delivery.trackingLimitTitle: Tracking stops when you leave this app
delivery.trackingLimitBody: Your phone only shares location while this page is open, in front, and the screen is on. Locking the phone, switching apps, or closing the browser stops new points from being recorded.
delivery.smsFallbackTitle: No signal? Send a checkpoint by SMS
delivery.smsFallbackBody: Text your job number with the checkpoint word, from the phone number registered to your account. Nothing to install and no data needed.
delivery.smsFallbackWords: Accepted words: PICKED or COLLECTED, LEFT or TRANSIT, ARRIVED or DELIVERED.
delivery.smsFallbackIntro: Send from the phone number registered to your account. Include the job number — without it the message is ignored.
delivery.smsOrderNote: Send each checkpoint as it happens. A message for a step the job has not reached yet will not move it.
delivery.locationPermissionDenied: Location access was blocked. Allow it for this site in your browser settings, then start again.
delivery.locationUnavailable: Your device could not provide a location fix. Check that location services are switched on.
delivery.syncJobFinished: This job was already finished, so its saved points were discarded.

tracking.title: Live delivery tracking
tracking.subtitle: Follow this delivery as it makes its way across South Omo.
tracking.staleWarning: This position has not changed for a while, so it may no longer be accurate.
tracking.offlineNotice: You are offline, so this is the last position we received.
tracking.noPositionBody: Once the driver starts sharing their location, it will appear here.
tracking.failedNotice: This delivery could not be completed. Please contact whoever placed the order.
tracking.completeNotice: This delivery has reached its final status, so live updates have stopped.
tracking.privacyNote: Anyone with this link can see this delivery’s status and position. Do not share it widely.
tracking.invalidTitle: This tracking link is not complete
tracking.invalidBody: Check the link you were sent. It should end with your tracking number.
tracking.notFoundTitle: We could not find this delivery
tracking.notFoundBody: The link may have expired, or the number may have been mistyped. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
tracking.unavailableTitle: Live tracking is unavailable right now
tracking.unavailableBody: We could not reach the tracking service. Your delivery is not affected.

trace.title: Product origin & traceability
trace.subtitle: Verified batch lineage from South Omo smallholders.
trace.originMissing: The producer has not recorded an origin for this batch.
trace.namesWithheld: The growers of this batch have chosen not to publish their names.
trace.invalidTitle: This trace link is not complete
trace.invalidBody: Check the code you scanned. It should end with the product’s trace number.
trace.notFoundTitle: We could not verify this product
trace.notFoundBody: The code may have been mistyped, or the product may not be registered yet. Check the code on the label.
trace.qrAlt: QR code linking to this product’s trace page
trace.scanAnotherBody: Point your camera at the code on the label, or type it in.
trace.manualLabel: Enter the code from your label
trace.manualPlaceholder: the code printed under the QR
trace.manualInvalid: That does not look like a trace code. Check the label and try again.
trace.cameraDenied: Camera access was blocked. Allow it for this site in your browser settings, or type the code below.
trace.cameraUnavailable: No camera could be used here. Type the code below instead.
trace.cameraInsecure: The camera needs a secure connection. Type the code below instead.
trace.cameraError: The camera could not start. Type the code below instead.
trace.noDetector: This browser cannot read codes with the camera, so you can type the code above.
trace.unavailableBody: We could not reach the traceability service. Please try again shortly.

sync.title: Pending sync
sync.summary: Changes saved on this device that have not been sent yet.
sync.emptyBody: Everything on this device has reached the server.
sync.stillQueued: Still queued — the server could not be reached.
sync.offline: You are offline. Sending is paused, but nothing here has been lost.
sync.loadFailedTitle: Could not read the pending queue
sync.loadFailedBody: Your queued changes are probably still on this device. Reload the page to try again.
sync.confirmChain: This removes this change and every later change for this job. Queued changes replay in order, so the ones behind it would be refused and lost anyway.
sync.confirmSingle: This removes the change from this device. It will never be sent.
